configuration.compileOnSave.enabled.mark: Always update the compiled PDF when a file is saved.
configuration.localReplica.syncMode.mark: Choose how this local replica synchronizes. Auto Sync: On applies stable, conflict-free changes automatically; Turning auto sync off records changes until you run Local Replica: Sync Now.
configuration.localReplica.enableCompile: Enable Overleaf compilation and PDF preview for this local replica. Changes take effect immediately. An explicit value here overrides the legacy `enableCompileNPreview` value in `.overleaf/settings.json`.
configuration.compileOutputFolderName.ma: The name of the folder where compiled output files such as `output.pdf` are shown.
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.markdownD: Configure the color themes used by the PDF viewer. New and refreshed PDF views use the updated themes.
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.fontColor: The font color of the theme.
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.backgroun: The background color of the theme.
configuration.pdfViewer.defaultScrollMod: Configure the default scroll mode used by the PDF viewer for new state. Existing saved viewer state takes precedence.
configuration.pdfViewer.defaultSpreadMod: Configure the default spread mode used by the PDF viewer for new state. Existing saved viewer state takes precedence.
